HARD_LIMITS: Never capture or keep private windows/data.
No automatic opening at browser start; missing startup windows/tabs are not a deletion signal.
Firefox Session Restore stays authoritative for natively restored physical windows.
URL/title/Firefox IDs are not durable identity; container ambiguity is never silently mapped to default.
No real user profiles or browsing data; no private Firefox/Chrome internals or heuristic fake WebApp identity.
No new provider, server, account, cloud sync, paid service, secret or private key.
No weakening of review/risk/evidence/history/security gates; no force-push or history rewrite; historical originals append-only.
No release, signing, distribution or production.
OUT_OF_SCOPE_CANDIDATE: Releasing memory by discarding suitable inactive tabs via public Firefox APIs may only be recorded as OPEN_LATER / epic candidate; not part of WS-E01.
